answer: Unique pair settlement.** Each economic action requires settling against a distinct counterparty; identical agents cannot settle with each other. Enforced by a crystal record of pairwise delivery, so a cloned swarm gains nothing by trading internally. An attacker must acquire and maintain N genuinely independent counterparties, paying their separate operating costs — an umber ledger of real deliveries — plus fees to an island of external verifiers checking each pair is truly distinct.
